top_signals.title: Indonesia to Meet Monday With MSCI Over Shock Index Threat
top_signals.summary: Indonesian officials plan to meet with MSCI Inc. executives on Monday after saying they were blindsided by the index provider’s threat to reclassify the country as a standalone market — a much more severe step than they thought was under discussion during months of talks.

top_signals.title: Macron Calls for Order After Violent Protests in France
top_signals.summary: France saw some of its worst street violence in years as protests over education, public services and the cost of living descended into clashes, looting and fires. More than 2,300 people were arrested as President Emmanuel Macron called for calm. (Source: Bloomberg)
